Plumbing Fixture Installation Checklist 19 checkpoints across 6 sections.After fixture installation; before building handover Download ExcelDownload PDF **19** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per unit/zone QC Engineer, Plumbing Supervisor [IS 2065:2015](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2065-1996) [IS 10500:2012](https://infralens.in/code/IS-10500-2012) Related [📐IS 2065](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2065) [✏️Ceiling Height Bathroom Wc](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/ceiling-height-bathroom-wc) [📘Water-Cement Ratio Guide](https://infralens.in/handbook/water-cement-ratio) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧hazen-williams-pipe-calcula…](https://infralens.in/tools/hazen-williams-pipe-calculator) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. FIXTURE MOUNTING & INSTALLATION | | A1 | Washbasin/sink/bathtub securely mounted to wall/floor; no movement when pushed or loaded (20 kg force)
Acceptance: Fixture does not shift under hand pressure, bolts/fasteners tight, no cracks on fixture or mounting surface | Cl. 15.1 — Installation security | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | WC pan properly seated on floor; sealant applied around base to prevent water seepage into subfloor
Acceptance: WC bolted to floor, sealant (silicone/tile adhesive) applied around perimeter, cured before use | Cl. 15.2 — WC base sealing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Fixture surface is free from chips, cracks, or manufacturing defects; glaze intact and smooth
Acceptance: Visual inspection for damage, no chips or cracks, surface glaze uniform, minor wear acceptable | Cl. 15.3 — Physical condition | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. WATER INLET CONNECTIONS | | B1 | Cold water inlet connected to dedicated cold water line (not mixed with hot water incorrectly routed)
Acceptance: Inlet traced to cold water supply, not connected to wrong source, valve operation verified | Cl. 16.1 — Source verification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Hot water inlet (if dual inlet) connected to hot water supply; temperature check conducted (40-50°C at outlet)
Acceptance: Hot water supply verified, temperature measured at outlet ≥40°C, thermostat valve present if required | Cl. 16.2 — Hot water verification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Inlet pipes properly connected; unions/compression fittings tight, no leakage when water turned on
Acceptance: Connections tight, tested at operating pressure, zero seepage at union/fitting, dry interface after 5 min | Cl. 16.3 — Connection integrity | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Isolating valve (stop cock) provided on each inlet line; accessible and operable
Acceptance: Stop valve present and accessible, operation tested (ON/OFF smooth), handle/knob not obstructed | Cl. 16.4 — Isolation provision | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. DRAINAGE OUTLET CONNECTIONS | | C1 | Drainage outlet properly connected to trap or P-bend; pipe diameter ≥32 mm for washbasin, ≥40 mm for bathtub
Acceptance: Drain pipe size adequate for fixture type, trap installed immediately after outlet, diameter matches fixture requirement | Cl. 17.1 — Drain sizing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | P-bend or S-bend trap properly installed; water seal maintained (min. 50 mm seal depth per design)
Acceptance: Water seal depth ≥50 mm visually confirmed, trap not siphoned, scent seal present if required | Cl. 17.2 — Trap sealing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Drain flows freely; no blockage or backflow observed during flow test
Acceptance: Drain empties within 10 seconds, no gurgling or slow drain, no backflow into fixture | Cl. 17.3 — Drainage functionality | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Overflow provision (if applicable): connected to drain system, not blocked
Acceptance: Overflow outlet clear, directed to drain system, not exposed to floor, prevents water damage | Cl. 17.4 — Overflow safety | OK
NC
NA
